query:
query Folders($active: Boolean, $ascendantFolderId: Int, $company: Boolean, $companyId: Int, $employee: Boolean, $employeeId: Int, $ids: [Int!], $parentFolderId: Int, $rootFolders: Boolean, $sort: String, $space: String, $url: String, $withCounters: Boolean, $withUnfilteredCounters: Boolean) {
  documents {
    folders(
      active: $active
      ascendantFolderId: $ascendantFolderId
      company: $company
      companyId: $companyId
      employee: $employee
      employeeId: $employeeId
      ids: $ids
      parentFolderId: $parentFolderId
      rootFolders: $rootFolders
      sort: $sort
      space: $space
      url: $url
      withCounters: $withCounters
      withUnfilteredCounters: $withUnfilteredCounters
    ) {
      ...DocumentsFolderItem
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment DocumentsFolderItem on DocumentsFolder {
  id
  active
  counterDocuments
  counterSubfolders
  identifier
  isCompany
  isEmployee
  isExpense
  isReadonly
  managePermission
  name
  parentFolder {
    id
    __typename
  }
  rootParentFolder {
    id
    __typename
  }
  showOnly
  slug
  space
  type
  url
  __typename
}
